column3: (Anti-clickjacking header missing: the gateway sets X-Frame-Options on every page it serves)
(X-Content-Type-Options missing: the gateway sets nosniff on every response)
(Content-Security-Policy missing: every HTML page the gateway serves has a CSP)
(Cookie without HttpOnly: every session cookie is HttpOnly)
(Cookie without SameSite: every session cookie is SameSite=Lax)
(Application error disclosure: no stack traces in responses)
(Absence of anti-CSRF tokens: CSRF is defended by SameSite cookies plus Origin checks, see SECURITY.md)
